## show-me-cat.webm
Generated: ffmpeg sine wave (synthetic audio)
Purpose: Placeholder for e2e tests (transcribe API is mocked)
License: N/A (synthetic test data)

---

These fixtures are used for Playwright e2e testing. The actual audio content
of show-me-cat.webm is not meaningful since the transcribe API is mocked
in tests to return "show me a cat" regardless of input.
